notes.blaster.title: The shooter's title, on its menu: one who blasts.
notes.blaster.tagline: Under the title: three stages of shooting at what comes toward you from the distance.
notes.blaster.menu.start: Play the three stages in a row.
notes.blaster.stage.harrier: Stage 1's name: a flying hero over a checkered plain. Also a menu entry that plays it alone.
notes.blaster.stage.burner: Stage 2's name: a jet over the sea. Also a menu entry.
notes.blaster.stage.safari: Stage 3's name: a ride through a valley, aiming a cursor. Also a menu entry.
notes.blaster.missiles: How many homing missiles are left, {n}.
notes.blaster.lock: Targets locked by the reticle, {n}; {key} fires missiles at them.
notes.action.fire: A control's name on the controls screen: fire the gun.
notes.action.missile: A control's name, and its touch button: fire missiles at the locked targets.
notes.action.roll: A control's name on the controls screen, and in capitals on its touch button: a barrel roll.
